verdict.rationale: The docs index lists first-party insights into recurring transactions, consumer spending and loan payments, plus credit-decisioning report APIs, all built on connected-account data. A test payroll provider (FinPayroll) suggests payroll connectivity. However, the evidence is only one-line index entries and never names income detection or an income-verification product. missing for 10: explicit income/payroll detection or income verification product documentation, detail on how recurring-stream and cash-flow signals are derived, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform derives income and cash-flow signals from connected accounts — recurring streams, payroll detection, or documented income verification products built on the same data

citations.quote: you will learn how to use our test banks (FinBanks) and test payroll provider (FinPayroll).
